_note: Pairs are aliases only where the PDF shows the same catalyst under the same conditions. Bahruji 2016 Table 4 labels the 5 wt% Pd/ZnO catalysts '5% Pd, SI' / '5% Pd, IM' (title: CO2 hydrogenation on Pd/ZnO catalysts at various Pd loadings prepared using IM and SI); Tables 5 and 6 call the same materials '5% Pd/ZnO SI' / '5% Pd/ZnO IM'. All three tables share the footnote 0.5 g catalyst, 30 ml/min 1CO2:3H2, 20 bar, 250 C (PDF p10-11). Jiang 2020: TheMeCat 'Cat-A(In2O3/ZrO2)' is the paper's In2O3/ZrO2 catalyst (p2-3: fresh/spent samples denoted Cat-A-F, Cat-A-S; Fig. 1a, 523 K, 5 MPa). Sharma 2023: TheMeCat 'In2O3' is the unsupported 'bulk In2O3' of the paper (p8 Section 3.3, same 493-573 K / 3.0 MPa runs). Ghosh 2022: TheMeCat 'In2O3/HZSM(Zeolite)' is the In2O3/HZSM-5 bed of Fig. 2 (0.67 g In2O3 + 0.33 g HZSM-5, 40 bar, 6000 mL gcat-1 h-1). Zaman 2023: 'PZC' is the paper's abbreviation for the undoped PdZn/CeO2 catalyst (p3 Table 1; TheMeCat 'PZC(PdZn/CeO2)'), same 230 C / 20 bar / 2400 h-1 runs. Chou 2019: Table 1 (p3) labels the 1.5 wt% Y-promoted catalyst '1.5YIn2O3/ZrO2'; the text calls it 1.5Y9In/ZrO2 and quotes the same 0.420 gMeOH gcat-1 h-1 at 573 K (p6).
